name: CNC Machining Center (Numerical Control Machining Center) - High-precision Metal Cutting and Part Processing
context: The CNC Machining Center system operates through the collaboration of three major modules:1. Requirement Module: Achieves high-precision machining requirements including micron-level positioning, temperature compensation, and vibration suppression. It supports intelligent multi-tool switching and real-time cutting monitoring.2. Function Module: Provides processing control for operators, equipment maintenance for technicians, and production management for managers.3.Architecture Module: Comprises five subsystems—control programming, mechanical transmission, tool management, cooling lubrication, and monitoring diagnosis. These subsystems seamlessly coordinate via an event-driven mechanism (e.g., program loading triggers automatic machine preparation, real-time tool wear alerts, and system-wide protective interlocking during malfunctions). The system ultimately achieves intelligent manufacturing goals including high-precision metal cutting, intelligent process optimization, and full-process visualization.
